detail: Read BRIEFS.md CHESS section; created repo/ layout; generated digit-encoded PST strings (scale (d-4)*8 cp) from classic material/PST tables

Wrote main.py v1: 0x88 board, full legal movegen (castling/en passant/promotions), negamax+alpha-beta+iterative deepening, quiescence with check evasions, MVV-LVA ordering, UCI loop with conservative time management. 6702 bytes pre-golf.
Added MIT LICENSE, README.md, and perft harness test/perft.py importing the shipped main.py as a module
Perft passed all 5 reference counts on v1 (startpos d3/d4, kiwipete d3, pos4 d4, pos5 d3); UCI suite passed except mate test expectation (engine found Qe8#, also mate)

Self-play exposed a real bug: timeout abort (TimeoutError) left search moves applied, corrupting the board. Fixed by snapshot/restore in GO (v1) and later unmake-on-raise in the search loop; verified by a dedicated state-integrity test on 4 positions x 2 think times

Golf rounds: merged make/unmake into MV(m,u), merged quiescence into the main search, data-driven castling, sign-product side tests, digit PSTs replaced by half-width mirrored tables; 6860 -> 4531 bytes; perft re-verified

Final golf: PSTs cut for a pawn-advancement formula eval, node counter replaced by per-node deadline check, root search inlined into the UCI loop, negated-score ordering, king-capture guard in the legal move list, quit handler restored. Final size 4078 bytes

On the shipped file: py_compile clean with -W error; perft 5/5 exact; state integrity 8/8 OK; UCI suite 11/11 PASS (incl. mate-in-1 Ra8#, free-queen capture, clock go 0.50s, mated->0000, clean quit); self-play 20 games: 10W/2B/8D, zero illegal moves, zero crashes, slowest move 0.06s. Recorded in TESTS.md

Timed-go defect: BM was overwritten live at the root during each iteration, so a deadline abort returned the partial iteration's first move (a1b1 instead of mate a1a8); mate was also invisible at depth 1 because quiescence leaves never checked for no-legal-moves. Fix: hoisted LM()+mate/stalemate return above the quiescence capture filter in SE; new global D gates the deadline raise so iteration 1 always completes (D=0) and aborts apply from iteration 2 (D=1); UCI loop snapshots m=BM only after a completed iteration. 4078 -> 4088 bytes

On the fixed file: timed regression 6/6 PASS (mate at wtime3000/movetime2000/movetime500/wtime10000 -> a1a8; free queen wtime3000 -> e1e8; midgame contest clock legal move in 0.46s); perft 5/5 exact; state integrity 8/8 OK; UCI suite ALL PASS; self-play 20 games zero illegal/crashes, all draws at 200-ply cap, slowest move 1.80s (one guaranteed depth-1 iteration). Final size 4088 bytes. Recorded in TESTS.md section 6
